Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.chess

Class ChessModel

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.chess.ChessModel
public class ChessModel extends Object
A complete chess engine: legal move generation (including castling, en passant and promotion), check / checkmate / stalemate / insufficient-material detection, and a negamax + alpha-beta opponent with a quiescence search and the standard simplified-evaluation piece-square tables.

The engine is pure Java (no lg3d / AWT dependency) so it can be exercised headlessly. The board is an int[64] indexed row * 8 + col with row 0 = rank 8 (Black's back rank) and col 0 = file a. Pieces are signed: positive = White, negative = Black; the magnitude is one of PAWN / KNIGHT / BISHOP / ROOK / QUEEN / KING. White always moves first and the human plays White; the AI plays Black.
